title: senecio sericeus var. neaei
intro: Senecio sericeus var. neaei, commonly known as Woolly Groundsel, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, as it has been used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Senecio sericeus var. neaei include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and triterpenes, which work to reduce inflammation, fight oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
